does: One frame of the render thread (the main thread, WinMain's loop through BaseApp::OnIdle): updates the global resource manager, starts the render frame system's worker batches, records and submits each render frame and presents it; the game's logic threads (client, server) run apart from it.

evidence.says: macOS BaseApp::OnIdle is one call, ls::RenderThread::Update(*(*(this+0x138)+0x40)); dx11's bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x3AC3510 has the same one-call shape (*(*(this+0x140)+0x20)) and is the only caller of this function
the sampler's stacks of the main thread in Running (W3 round 1) run under it 100%, through WinMain bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x5777D0
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
